exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal, trans caesarean section)
cohort: The participants were women who delivered either vaginally or by trans caesarean section at the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, SIMS/Services Hospital, Lahore.
finding: The study found 74% awareness and 30% acceptance of PPIUCD, with an overall expulsion rate of 5.4% at 6 weeks follow-up.
